stem.text: The graph represents a sound wave.

stem.alt: Displacement in micrometres against time in milliseconds for a wave. Vertical axis marked 3 and -3; horizontal axis marked 0 to 55 in steps of 5 ms. A sinusoidal curve is drawn.

A.text: The wave is longitudinal and has a period of $25\,\text{ms}$.

B.text: The wave is longitudinal and has a frequency of $50\,\text{Hz}$.

C.text: The wave is transverse and has an amplitude of $3\,\mu\text{m}$.

D.text: The wave is transverse and has a wavelength of $20\,\text{ms}$.
